# Tabler template

Agent Memory Hub uses the official Tabler Core 1.6.1 assets and adapts the original Tabler preview layout components into JSP views.

- `css/tabler.min.css`, its source map, and `js/tabler.min.js` are the official compiled Tabler Core assets.
- The JSP shell follows the Tabler vertical `DefaultLayout` structure, and the sign-in view follows `SingleLayout` and `SignInCard`.
- Navigation, cards, forms, alerts, empty states, badges, and tables use Tabler's own component classes and markup.
- `icons.svg` contains the outline icons used by Agent Memory Hub, from `@tabler/icons` 3.49.0.
- Third-party demo plugins are not bundled; Agent Memory Hub does not use them.
- Both projects are MIT-licensed. See `LICENSE-core.txt` and `LICENSE-icons.txt`.
- Template source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler/tree/0647af1b9be59454a00adf012663b5ec58d44b24
